app.name: Tasklace
app.tagline: Plan a project on a Gantt chart, alone or together.

notices.label: Messages

repairs.one: {count} change was adjusted to keep the project valid.
repairs.other: {count} changes were adjusted to keep the project valid.

notices.scheduleFailed: The schedule could not be computed. Check the calendar and the start date of the project.

exportFailed.SCHEDULE_MISMATCH: The table could not be written while the schedule was being updated. Try again.
exportFailed.UNKNOWN_BLOCK: The table could not be written: a link names a block its task does not have. Check the links of the split tasks.

notices.projectStartMoved: The project now starts on {date}, so that this task can start earlier.

tasks.outdent: Outdent: move out of its summary

editErrors.NOT_POSSIBLE: This change is not possible here.
editErrors.INVALID_DURATION: Write the duration in hours, such as 14 or 1 h 30, in minutes, such as 45 min, or in working days, such as 2d.
editErrors.INVALID_DATE: This date could not be read. Write it as your computer shows dates, or as 2026-10-05 14:30. Times go by quarter hours.
editErrors.INVALID_PROGRESS: Write the progress as a whole number from 0 to 100.
editErrors.INVALID_PREDECESSORS: Write the predecessors by task number, such as 1.2, 3SS+2h, or 3#2 for block 2 of task 3, each one once.
editErrors.UNKNOWN_BLOCK: The task you named has no block with this number. Blocks are counted from 1, on split tasks only.
editErrors.LINKS_WOULD_MERGE: Two different links of this task would become the same link. Remove one of them first.
editErrors.WAITS_NEED_TWO_BLOCKS: A task with a single block cannot wait apart from itself. Write what it waits for in Predecessors.
editErrors.TASK_CHANGED: This task changed while its details were open. Close them and open them again.
editErrors.UNKNOWN_TASK_NUMBER: There is no task with this number.
editErrors.DEPENDENCY_CYCLE: This link would make tasks wait for each other in a loop.
editErrors.SUMMARY_DEPENDENCY: Summary tasks cannot be linked. Link the tasks inside them.
editErrors.SELF_DEPENDENCY: A task cannot be linked to itself.
editErrors.HIERARCHY_TOO_DEEP: Tasks cannot be nested this deeply.
editErrors.TOO_MANY_ITEMS: The project has reached its maximum size.
editErrors.OUT_OF_RANGE: This value is outside the allowed range.
editErrors.INVALID_END: A task has to end after it starts.
editErrors.INVALID_BLOCK: Write the duration of each block, such as 4 h or 1 h 30.
editErrors.INVALID_GAP: Write the days between two blocks as a whole number, 0 for the same day.
editErrors.INVALID_HOURS_PER_DAY: Hours per day go from 1 hour to the length of a working day, by quarter hours.
editErrors.INVALID_DAILY_START: Write the daily start time as 13:30, on a quarter hour, leaving enough working hours after it.
editErrors.DAILY_START_HOUR_CLEARED: Write the daily start time as 13:30, on a quarter hour, leaving enough working hours after it.

details.title: Task details
details.name: Name
details.startHint: Leave empty to start as soon as possible.
details.hoursPerDayHint: Leave empty to work the whole working day.
details.dailyStartHint: Leave empty to start at the first working hour of each day.
details.blocksHint: Split the task into several blocks to pause it and resume it later. A block can wait for other tasks, or for a block of them written 3#2 (block 2 of task 3).
details.milestoneHint: A milestone marks a key date with no duration, such as a delivery or an approval. Link tasks to it to show what they lead to or wait for.
